0022600151.text: Milwaukee hosts Cleveland in the Bucks' sixth game of the season, and the Bucks enter at 1-4 overall (1-2 at home, 0-2 on the road), 13th in the East and 3.5 games behind for fourth in the Central, on a one-game losing streak. The Cavaliers are 3-2, fifth in the East and 1.5 games behind for second in the Central, with a 3-0 home record and a 0-2 road record, and they are also on a one-game losing streak. Cleveland's Jaylon Tyson is out with an ankle sprain and Meleek Thomas is day-to-day with a foot injury and is a game-time decision, while the two teams have not yet met this season after Cleveland won the 2025-26 series 3-1, including a 123-116 win over Milwaukee in Milwaukee on March 17, 2026.
